admission.anti_gaming: The candidate is fixed solely by quant and production shape; no token, prompt, expert-ID, route, or output-dependent selection is allowed.
admission.leaf_performance: Use all 45 actual IQ3 weights and natural-M512 routing, five warmups, at least 15 counter-rotated samples and five launches/sample. Every complete output must match H6F byte-for-byte and every layer must improve both HIP event and synchronized-wall medians. Any failure removes all H6I surfaces.
admission.physical: Require cached code-object proof of output stride 0x300, four loop epochs, eight dynamic barriers per rowbatch, 216 useful FMAs for three outputs, private0/spill0/scratch0, metadata and runtime VGPR <=224, LDS <=768 bytes, and unchanged local128/grid32768x64.
admission.red_first: Before executable changes, freeze a separately named gfx1100 H6F sibling; rows1/7/8/9/M512, active-count P64/P65, reversed traversal, every first/middle/last triplet boundary, complete H6F bytes, sampled CPU bytes, exact 104370208-byte MoE scratch, unchanged source map/ABI map, strict K1024/N3072/E256 preflight, and gfx1151 absence.
admission.runtime_if_leaf_admitted: Only then freeze a separate default-off capability through the existing grouped_raw_iq_active_experts ABI/raw allocation/library. Require complete natural-M512 state, exact 45-call cached topology, unchanged 161120256-byte workspace/600141856-byte total scratch, and clean one-queue 512/1K/4K wins.
admission.source_if_runtime_admitted: Require separate source-default RED, fixed natural C4096/direct-M512 and selector-unset 512/1K/4K exact paired wins before changing H6F production.
